# Regions

This folder contains pages for the administrative regions of Denmark, which serve as the primary geographical and organizational stratification level in the national healthcare quality monitoring system for atrial fibrillation. The pages detail the healthcare infrastructure, hospital units, and health clusters within specific regions like Midtjylland and Syddanmark, alongside their epidemiological data and performance against national clinical quality indicators. A general overview page explains how these five regions are used to analyze and report treatment safety and outcomes across the country.

## Pages

- [[region-midtjylland|Region Midtjylland — Midtjylland]] — Details the healthcare infrastructure, clinical performance, and epidemiological data for the Central Denmark Region, including its hospitals, health clusters, and adherence to national quality indicators for atrial fibrillation care.
- [[region-syddanmark|Region Syddanmark — Syddanmark]] — Covers the Region of Southern Denmark's role in the national atrial fibrillation registry, outlining its hospital units, health clusters, and regional compliance with clinical quality standards and treatment practices.
- [[regioner]] — Explains the use of Denmark's five administrative regions as the primary geographical stratification level for analyzing national healthcare quality indicators, such as the incidence of severe bleeding among anticoagulated patients.
